1. Explicit Security ID / Security ID explícito

ENGLISH

J.R. brought up having TBI send the Incident Security ID directly instead of deriving it from the teams file. Do you think that would actually get us around the issue in ENG-10069, or would it still go through the same assignment step? If it could help, which file and field would we use, what values would it accept, and how would that interact with the team mapping and any manual overrides?

Why I’m asking

I'm asking because J.R. specifically raised this on the call as a possible way to unblock TBI sooner. In Rachel's case, the level was already available in SSO+, but the account was still created with a blank Security ID. So before we ask TBI to change its file, I'd like to understand whether an explicit field would change that outcome or still hit the same assignment step.

2. New and existing users / Usuarios nuevos y existentes

ENGLISH

For Rachel, level 5 was already in SSO+ before her account was created, but that first sign in left her Security ID blank while the groups and team were added. Christi also had a blank account level even though she had an older persistent assignment. Do you think ENG-10069 covers both cases, or should we look at the existing user case separately?

Why I’m asking

I'm asking because we have evidence from two different account histories. Rachel's creation log shows a NULL Security ID even though her level 5 row had loaded earlier that day. For Christi, the investigation recorded a persistent level 5 assignment from April and a July login, but her account level was blank when checked in October. That doesn't prove two separate defects, but it means I don't want to assume a first-login fix covers every example TBI showed.

Rachel · published investigation / investigación publicada · Christi · investigation notes / notas de investigación

ESPAÑOL

Por qué lo pregunto

Lo pregunto porque tenemos evidencia de dos historias de cuenta diferentes. El log de creación de Rachel muestra un Security ID NULL aunque su fila con nivel 5 se había cargado más temprano ese día. Para Christi, la investigación registró una asignación persistente de nivel 5 desde abril y un inicio de sesión en julio, pero el nivel de su cuenta estaba vacío cuando se revisó en octubre. Eso no demuestra dos defectos separados, pero significa que no quiero asumir que una corrección del primer inicio de sesión cubra todos los ejemplos que mostró TBI.

3. Getting people working / Recuperar el acceso

ENGLISH

Who would handle that, how would we preserve intentional manual settings, and what would you want us to validate before doing it?

Why I’m asking

I'd like us to agree on a supported recovery path rather than leave people waiting for another attempt.

6. What actually loaded / Qué se cargó realmente

ENGLISH

The other thing I'd like to clear up is the feed. In the October 15 checks, the security assignment timestamps were still at October 13. Ryan saw ReferenceDataBackLoad run without errors, and TBI showed a file named for October 14. What's the best way to confirm which file actually reached SSO+? With SnowTime, would we expect those row timestamps to stay the same when nothing changes?

Why I’m asking

I'm asking because the observations don't yet establish what happened to the feed. The October 15 checks found security assignment timestamps from October 13, Ryan saw the replication task run without errors, and TBI showed a file with October 14 in its name. None of those alone proves which file was received and processed. Ryan also said the legacy scripts might not reflect the current SnowTime process, so I'd like to identify the right processing evidence and timestamp expectations.

Precisiones para la conversación

Ryan indicó que aparentemente agregamos el 9; falta comprobar la regla actual de SnowTime. No asumir reemplazo masivo por 4. Una tarea exitosa no prueba qué archivo se procesó. Un segundo login no es una solución universal validada. El campo explícito todavía es una opción por evaluar.

Ryan said it appears we add the 9; the current SnowTime rule still needs verification. Do not assume a bulk replacement with 4. Successful task execution does not prove which file was processed. A second login is not a validated universal fix. An explicit Security ID remains an option to evaluate.

Estado comprobado al preparar: RCS-29451 Accepted into Development, Shandana Khan. ENG-10069 Backlog, sin asignar. Los enlaces permiten revisar cambios posteriores.
